method: Third walk, after the two in walks/2026-11-04-buyer-walk.json. Kar read the served page cold as the same four buyers, rendered with its scripts running, and used it as a buyer would: pressed every button (both drafts, gate, seal, tamper, ledger, flip), changed the cost inputs (including an out-of-range share), and gated drafts of its own against edited receipts.

Every statement a buyer would rely on was checked against the code it describes: kernel.mjs, cli.mjs, scripts/claim-receipt-gate.mjs, make-zip.mjs, costcase.mjs, LICENSE and the page's own scripts. The browser's network log was read for the served page.
No local-model pass this time: the first walk's local qwen2.5:7b outputs are kept in the 2026-11-04 record; this pass needed claims checked against code and the gate driven by hand.

gaps.gap: A real fault in the gate. Trying the honest receipt with a fact 'cut review time 30% on one team', the draft 'review time down 3%' PASSED: a percent was backed by any fact containing its digits ('3' is inside '30%'), and a score by any fact containing its text ('1/4' is inside '11/40'). The page said the gate 'never waves a number through'.
gaps.done: fixed in kernel.mjs: a fact backs a percent only when it states the same whole number as a percent ('30%', '30 percent', '30 per cent'), and a K/N score only when it states the same whole K/N (spaces round the slash allowed); neither side of the number may continue it. Two new tests cover every edge (digits before and after, decimals, start of the fact, a full stop after, case, 'percentage points', a count that is not a percent). 62 tests pass; witness v0.6 uncapped 89/91 killed, 0 survivors, the same 2 reviewed equivalents baselined with their existing written reasons; receipts/witness.json re-written for the new kernel. The examples' reports are unchanged byte for byte.

gaps.gap: 'Search it for fetch, http or net. make-zip.mjs does exactly that and fails the build if it finds one': not true as written. 'http' is in the script (comments and the link pattern) and 'fetch' is in a comment; make-zip looks for network CALLS and allows URL text as a declared pattern.
gaps.done: rewritten: the only import is node:fs; the network calls to search for are named; where 'fetch' and 'http' do appear is said; make-zip's check is described as it is.
